messages.subject: Adjusting text to error bars
parts:
Hi!

I would like to have labels for each point adjusted to the error bar
position rather than the point itself in order to avoid overlapping of
text and error bars.

Here's an example:

df <- data.frame(
y = runif(10,0,1),
er = runif(10,0,0.1),
x = seq(1:10),
lab = rep("a",10))

limits = aes(ymin = y - er, ymax = y + er)

ggplot(df, aes(x, y, label=lab)) + geom_point() +
geom_errorbar(limits) + geom_text(vjust=3)


Thank you for your help!

Guillaume

Guillaume Théroux Rancourt, agr., M.Sc.
Ph.D. Student - Plant Biology
Université Laval, Québec, QC, Canada

Hi:

Is something like this what you had in mind?

ggplot(df, aes(x, y, label=lab)) + geom_point() +
geom_errorbar(limits) + geom_text(aes(y = df$y - df$er - 0.03))

HTH,
Dennis
